svg.title: Degree-three open spline through source points / 元の点を通る非閉鎖の3次スプライン
svg.desc: A cubic Bezier example passes exactly through four orange points at parameters zero, one third, two thirds and one. The gray polyline only shows their order; it is not a control polygon used instead of interpolation.

g.text: Through Points, not control-polygon only / 点を通過するスプライン
SCHEMATIC / 模式図 · Automotive seal reference path / 自動車のシール基準経路の例
3次・非閉鎖・関連付けあり
At least four points · G1/G2/G3 = None / 4点以上必要・G1/G2/G3拘束なし
